# Net Infotech System Pvt. Ltd. (NISPL)

> Net Infotech System Pvt. Ltd. (NISPL) is Eastern India's premier IT solutions provider and Certified Tally 3-Star Partner. Headquartered at Webel Tower 1, Sector V, Salt Lake City, Kolkata - 700091, NISPL provides enterprise cloud hosting, Tally on Cloud, 24/7 managed IT services, cybersecurity defense, Microsoft licensing, IT infrastructure management, and CtrlS Kolkata Rated-4 datacenter colocation.

## Core Navigation Pages

- [Homepage](https://nispl.netlify.app/): Main enterprise portal showcasing full IT services, cloud hosting, certified technology partners, and premier client testimonials.
- [About Us & Work Culture](https://nispl.netlify.app/about): Company legacy, 25+ years of industry track record, awareness programs, leadership summits, and authentic workplace culture.
- [Contact & Support](https://nispl.netlify.app/contact): Official contact directory, Webel Tower 1 Kolkata headquarters, support helpline (+91 9330113000), and inquiry form.
- [Careers](https://nispl.netlify.app/career): Job vacancies, cloud engineering roles, Tally consulting positions, and online job application portal.

## Core Services & Solutions

1. **TallyPrime & Tally on Cloud Solutions**
   - High-speed cloud VPS hosting for TallyPrime with 99.9% uptime.
   - Anywhere, anytime access from Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android.
   - Automated hourly encrypted backups, bank-grade 256-bit SSL, and GST compliance e-invoicing.
   - Certified 3-Star Tally Partner delivering deployment, licensing, and custom module integrations.

2. **Enterprise Cloud Server & VPS Hosting**
   - High-availability virtual private servers (VPS), dedicated cloud instances, and elastic storage arrays.
   - Automated daily snapshots, multi-branch database synchronization, and enterprise DDoS protection.

3. **IT Infrastructure Management**
   - Enterprise rack server architecture, high-density storage arrays, and carrier-neutral low-latency switching fabrics.
   - High-throughput corporate Wi-Fi fabrics and multi-office network integration.

4. **24/7 Managed IT Services & IT AMC Support**
   - Central 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) in Kolkata monitoring servers, firewalls, and network switches.
   - Guaranteed SLA response times (< 15 min triage), scheduled preventive maintenance, and SLA hardware replacement.

5. **Cyber Security Solutions & Zero-Trust Defense**
   - Multi-layered hardware UTM firewalls, encrypted VPN gateways, and centralized endpoint governance.
   - Bank-grade 256-bit encryption, phishing defense, real-time intrusion prevention, and ransomware defense.

6. **Microsoft 365 Licensing & Cloud Modernization**
   - Official Microsoft Solutions Partner providing Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange, Windows Server, Entra ID, and Intune device fleet management.

7. **CtrlS Kolkata Rated-4 Datacenter Colocation**
   - 16 MW AI-ready facility at Bengal Silicon Valley, New Town Kolkata with 99.995% uptime SLA and military-grade physical security.
